summary: Massive reactive UAV launches from multiple Russian airfields (Hvardiiske, Orel, Millerovo) targeted Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr, Chernivtsi, and Ivano-Frankivsk regions overnight. Russian forces struck critical energy infrastructure in Kirovohrad region, damaging railway power substations and causing partial blackouts, while an enterprise in Chernihiv was hit killing one and injuring one. Enemy ground forces advanced near Petropavlivka on the eastern front as a third Tu-160 strategic bomber relocated to Engels for cruise missile arming.

Geran-5 rocket penetrated Kyiv airspace flying through Velyka Dymerka toward Desnianskyi district and Brovary (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78799)
Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat reported from Bryansk region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78801)
Kirovohrad region critical infrastructure attacked: railway power substations hit, fires extinguished, partial blackout (Source: @eRadarrua/133432)
Chernihiv enterprise strike killed one civilian and injured one (Source: @eRadarrua/133433)
Enemy advanced near Petropavlivka per updated frontline map (Source: @DeepStateUA/24030)
Third Tu-160 relocated from Far East to Engels airfield for cruise missile arming (Source: @eRadarrua/133402)
Ukraine halted electricity exports; imports highest since mid-June after November 20 NPP generation cuts (Source: @UkraineNow/85582)

sections.executive_summary: Massive reactive UAV launches from multiple Russian airfields (Hvardiiske, Orel, Millerovo) targeted Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr, Chernivtsi, and Ivano-Frankivsk regions overnight. Russian forces struck critical energy infrastructure in Kirovohrad region, damaging railway power substations and causing partial blackouts, while an enterprise in Chernihiv was hit killing one and injuring one. Enemy ground forces advanced near Petropavlivka on the eastern front as a third Tu-160 strategic bomber relocated to Engels for cruise missile arming.

points: Ukraine halted electricity exports and imports reached highest level since mid-June after November 20 Russian attack forced NPPs to reduce generation due to transmission constraints (Source: @UkraineNow/85582).
250 bodies of Ukrainian servicemen returned from Russian-held territory per Russian side claim (Source: @UkraineNow/85563).
Nine children returned from occupied Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, and Crimea; total 2,875 children repatriated since war start (Source: @UkraineNow/85585).

Starlink/Starshield connectivity restored in Ukraine-controlled territory but restrictions persist in occupied areas; Zelenskyy attributes decision to SpaceX technically, politically unclear (Source: @UkraineNow/85569).
Prime Minister Korenetskyi stated military salary increases and pension reform require tens of billions UAH monthly, exceeding budget capacity (Source: @UkraineNow/85578).
24 EU countries supported additional financial aid to Ukraine; final decision pending at November 26-27 summit (Source: @UkraineNow/85575).
Ukraine received $450 million from World Bank in two $225M tranches with Japanese support under R programs (Source: @DeepStateUA/24028).
Third Tu-160 strategic bomber relocated from Far East to Engels airfield for cruise missile arming, indicating sustained long-range strike preparation (Source: @eRadarrua/133402).
Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat detected from Bryansk region targeting Ukrainian territory (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78801).
Geran-5 rocket penetrated Kyiv airspace via Velyka Dymerka toward Desnianskyi district and Brovary (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78799).
Massive reactive UAV launches from Hvardiiske (4 groups), Orel (2 groups), Millerovo (1 group) overnight November 27 (Source: @eRadarrua/133455).
Russian strike on Kirovohrad critical infrastructure hit railway power substations, caused fires at two locations, partial blackout, no casualties (Source: @eRadarrua/133432).
Russian strike on Chernihiv enterprise killed one civilian, injured one (Source: @eRadarrua/133433).
Fire at St. Petersburg warehouse of ventilation equipment and construction machinery company burned 500 sq m; cause unknown (Source: @eRadarrua/133444).
Enemy forces advanced near Petropavlivka per DeepState map update November 27 (Source: @DeepStateUA/24030).

Reactive UAVs detected over Kharkiv region: strike UAV toward Chuhuiv, reactive UAVs on southern Kharkiv region course west, past Zlatopil westward (Source: @kpszsu/99715, @kpszsu/99742, @kpszsu/99740).
Reactive UAVs in Poltava region: Banderoil maneuvering past Hnatynky toward Kotelva, reactive UAV course to Pyriatyn (Source: @eRadarrua/133422, @kpszsu/99722).
Sumy region: strike UAV group and Molniya/Recon UAVs detected (Source: @eRadarrua/133442, @eRadarrua/133457).
Chernihiv region: multiple reactive UAV groups (3-4) including along Belarus border (Source: @eRadarrua/133436, @eRadarrua/133442, @kpszsu/99717).
No specific ground combat reports beyond Petropavlivka advance; drone activity indicates persistent ISR and strike pressure.
Russian Tu-160 relocation to Engels suggests potential future cruise missile strikes on eastern Ukraine targets (Source: @eRadarrua/133402).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia maintains high-intensity air campaign combining mass reactive UAV launches from multiple airfields with ballistic missile threats and novel Geran-5 jet drones penetrating deep into Ukrainian airspace including Kyiv. Critical energy infrastructure remains primary target, as evidenced by Kirovohrad railway substation strikes causing blackouts. Tu-160 relocation to Engels signals sustained long-range cruise missile capacity. Ground advances near Petropavlivka suggest continued pressure in eastern Donetsk sector. Ukrainian air defense faces saturation challenge across broad front from Chernihiv to Ivano-Frankivsk.
sections.regional_response: EU financial aid package for Ukraine advanced with 24 countries supporting additional assistance pending November 27 summit unanimity. Czech President Pavel and PM Babiš publicly split over Ukraine funding from EU budget, reflecting political fractures. World Bank disbursed $450M with Japanese backing for Ukrainian budget support. Armenian PM announced full replacement of Russian border guards, signaling regional security realignment. German defense industry demonstrated high-speed interceptor drone technology potentially applicable against Russian jet UAVs.
sections.intelligence_notes: Reactive UAV launch patterns show consistent use of Hvardiiske (Crimea), Orel, and Millerovo airfields for mass Shahed/Geran waves. Geran-5 appearance over Kyiv indicates deployment of higher-speed jet-powered variants challenging air defense reaction times. Iskander-M threat from Bryansk suggests continued ballistic missile readiness. Starlink restrictions in occupied territories persist despite restoration in government-controlled areas, implying Russian electronic warfare or SpaceX geofencing. Tu-160 fleet expansion at Engels (third bomber) enhances Russian strategic strike flexibility. Petropavlivka advance aligns with Russian push toward Kurakhove-Pokrovsk axis.
